messages.subject: Re: Does RHadoop support all R packages exclude core pacakges ? like TSA or other time serise package ?
parts:
No, unfortunately RHadoop does not support any package. So far we've found it compatible with a number of packages but we haven't thought of compiling a list. Being a daunting task, I suppose this should be a community effort.  I am happy to start a page on our wiki if there is interest.


Antonio
